meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why did Owen get a zero before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. Now why was it entered at all?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
People draft elsewhere and paste it in. Why does that make it anything but a drafting habit?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Okay. Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Students misquote plays all the time. Since when is a wrong line a crime?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Okay. Under which section was the zero entered, and when was Owen heard?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their argument between an outline and an essay. Isn't that what revising is?

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. That's 4.4, in writing, with nothing on his record. I'm agreeing to put this behind him, not because he did anything.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Owen works after school. Put the date and time in the email and I'll confirm.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, after school and not in front of his class, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. I still demand all of that in writing, along with the date and time of the rewrite so I can confirm them with Owen. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite replacing the zero, with nothing on his record, and she still wants it all in writing plus a rewrite time that works around Owen's job; that is the fair outcome, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You answered her defence about drafting elsewhere by asking for that earlier draft with its date, which made the version history stand as something she could check.
What cost ground: Nothing hurt you badly, though you offered the rewrite before answering her point that students change their argument between an outline and an essay.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay's text appearing close to midnight on an October night, which came near that memory, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When you offered the rewrite, you could have first answered her question about the outline and the changed argument, so the deal rested on all three pieces.
